newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: CMS unit gives $38.2 mln loan to Manila firm.
newsitem.headline: CMS unit gives $38.2 mln loan to Manila firm.

text.p: CMS Capital Corp, an affiliate of US-based CMS Energy Corp, provided a $38.2 million bridge financing loan to Magellan Capital Holdings Corp (MCHC), MCHC subsidiary Ultrana Energy & Resources Corp said on Friday.
The loan is payable after 18 months.
The loan proceeds will be used to pay the debts of Ultrana affiliate, Magellan Cogeneration Inc (MCI), and finance the refurbishment and expansion of its 63-megawatt power plant.

Ultrana also said the Securities and Exchange Commission had approved the change of its name to F.J. Prince Holdings Corp as well as the change in its primary purpose to that of a holding company from a mining firm.
